scope: Screen additional open CAD/parser/kernel routes for independently useful SAT/SAB/AcDs semantic evidence; separate advertised format names, parser recognition, kernel features, and executable semantic qualification.

sourceTypes: OpenCADStudio kernel and codec project documentation
DXF parser feature matrices and source-profile documentation
method.evidenceBoundary: Repository/product documentation is source-reported capability, not behavior reproduced on libdxfrw output. A typed entity or feature flag is not proof of carrier retention, valid B-rep, or native target acceptance. No new peer was admitted as a support oracle.

observed: The page reports SAT-text import/export, two public NIST SAT examples, and a project-authored sample.
The page explicitly refuses binary SAB with SAT_BINARY_UNSUPPORTED.
The public page does not identify an auditable source repository or open-source license.
The sample's same-project re-import and reported metrics are not independent semantic evidence.
findings.planUse: Do not count as an open-source implementation or semantic witness. Revisit only as a separately labeled SAT-text route if source/license, exact executable, input provenance, and independent expected values become available. It cannot qualify SAB, DXF ACDSDATA, or DWG AcDs.

observed: The broad README headline lists ACIS among many categories, but the detailed table marks ACIS SAT/SAB read and write unsupported or planned.
findings.planUse: Retain DISCOVERY_ONLY / ACIS_UNSUPPORTED and skip installation/build for ACIS parity unless the detailed, versioned route changes.

observed: opencadkernel describes an early optional lift from SatDocument into its B-rep layer.
OpenCADStudio's codec family is ACadRust-derived, so a separate kernel implementation does not add an independent DWG/DXF or ACIS parser vote.
The feature description alone does not establish completeness for the chosen body topology or absence of fallback.
findings.planUse: Keep the existing one-time capability preflight and optional cross-kernel application check; if required operations are missing, record NOT_AVAILABLE and do not build an adapter or add dependencies.

observed: dxfjs advertises 3DSOLID dispatch, but its advertised entity name does not establish carrier decoding or B-rep interpretation; prior source inspection did not find retained OBJECTS output in the returned model.
DXFReader explicitly supports ASCII only, has no writer, and marks both 3DFACE and 3DSOLID unsupported.
findings.planUse: Do not schedule these for modern-solid or semantic execution. Reconsider only for a concrete, source-audited parser behavior not already covered by local tests.

observed: The project warns that typed 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY writer outputs may not open in AutoCAD.
findings.planUse: Preserve target-reader/native-application acceptance as a separate composed gate; class presence, same-codec round-trip, or peer output cannot substitute.

refinesExistingOwners: S8 peer admission and comparator order
implementationReadiness.fastImplementationDecision: Do not add screened peers to per-slice validation, CMake, CI, or dependencies. Continue focused local tests; at the existing composed checkpoint prioritize only an exact pinned, source-audited ACIS parser profile plus independently authored analytic expectations.
